headline: Nvidia falls 5% as investors weigh risks surrounding Huang's return as CEO
summary: Nvidia shares fell 5.2% to $156.40, dragging down AI-related stocks more broadly, as investors weighed risks around Jensen Huang's return as chief executive.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so its share price moves often signal sentiment across the AI sector.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: Shares fell 5.2% on investor concern about leadership risk.
